summary: Comprehensive backend+frontend regression for SentinelGuard. Ran 19 pytest cases (all passed) covering secure/chat pipeline (MASK email via PII policy, BLOCK API key/CC via Secrets/PCI policies, ALLOW clean prompts through Gemini/OpenAI/Claude via emergentintegrations, phone MASK, combo score higher, Local AI error surface, multi-turn same session_id, empty message 400), events (no raw PII leakage, labels only), dashboard stats shape/providers, policies CRUD end-to-end with live effect on secure/chat + restore, audit-logs pagination+filter+search, settings GET/PUT+persistence. UI E2E via Playwright with pre-seeded QA session cookie verified Dashboard (title/4 metrics/4 providers/refresh), Console (Gemini MASK flow with real AI response 'Hello... [EMAIL_MASKED]', analysis panel showing MASKED badge/email/score 15/PII standard protection/original->masked, BLOCKED path for sk- api key with blocked-message and BLOCKED badge, new-conversation reset), Live Events (18 rows, search filters to 6), Policies (4 seeded, create UITEST_ policy, toggle, delete + reload persistence confirmed), Audit Logs (rows, modal open/close, BLOCKED filter 6 rows, search Gemini works), Settings (toggle+save persists across reload, restored). Unauthenticated visit correctly redirected to /login with Google sign-in card (data-testid=google-sign-in-button).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses synchronous requests.get inside the async exchange_auth_session handler (blocks event loop) - consider httpx.AsyncClient (already imported).
backend/.env still contains legacy JWT/Postgres/admin credentials that are unused after the Mongo-only rewrite; safe to remove to reduce confusion.
policy delete has no confirm dialog / no undo - UX consideration, not a bug.
CORS uses allow_origins=[] + allow_origin_regex='.*' with allow_credentials=True; permissive but works because Starlette echoes the exact Origin. Fine for preview, tighten for prod.
test_credentials: session_token=test_session_sentinelguard_qa (pre-seeded QA session, works via cookie and Bearer)
seed_data_creation: Test-only ephemeral policies (TEST_email_block, UITEST_*) and chat/event records were created and cleaned up (policies deleted after each test). Some smoke-test events remain from prior sessions, which is expected.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend and full UI wiring verified end-to-end with real Emergent LLM responses (Gemini/OpenAI/Claude). Reuse /app/backend/tests/test_sentinelguard_backend.py for regression. LLM calls take 3-15s so keep 60s timeouts on secure/chat. Local AI intentionally not-configured. Default policies auto-seeded on startup only when collection empty - if you drop the policies collection you must restart backend.
